print_id.description: Print daemon-assigned notification ID on stdout (format: id=ID)

print_reason.description: Print notification closure reason on stdout (format: reason=EXPIRED|DISMISSED|FORCE-CLOSED|UNKNOWN)

print_token.description: Print activation token on stdout (format: xdgtoken=TOKEN)

app_name.description: Application name; displayed as text or used for icon lookup

icon.description: Icon name (symbolic, e.g. 'firefox') or absolute filename

expire_time.description: Auto-close after N milliseconds (0 = no timeout)

replaces_id.description: Replace existing notification with this ID (if non-zero)

actions.description: List of action definitions; implies --wait when present. Format: NAME:LABEL (NAME machine-readable, LABEL user-facing)

image_data_file.description: Path to raw RGBA image file (requires --image-size)
